difficulty_reason: The proof is a three-way equivalence with real module arguments: (1) implies sheafness via faithful flatness of the $\check{\mathrm{C}}$ech algebra of a standard \'etale covering and the ff-exactness lemma, then implies quasi-coherence by transporting free presentations along the tensor isomorphisms; (2) implies (3) by intrinsicness of quasi-coherence under the site equivalence; (3) implies (1) by computing sections of pullbacks and applying the affine-tensor lemma.
